title: Access Nested Property
description:
Write a function that safely accesses a nested property in an object using a dot-separated path string. Return undefined if any part of the path doesn't exist.

Example:
- Input: { a: { b: { c: 42 } } }, "a.b.c" → Output: 42
- Input: { a: { b: 1 } }, "a.c" → Output: undefined
hints: Split the path by '.' to get an array of keys.
Walk through each key, checking if the current value exists before going deeper.
